title: Artifact authority profile (AG-local declaration) — CANDIDATE, non-binding
description: A producer's LOCAL declaration of what an artifact kind can testify to. AG-local vocabulary: field names shared with other projects' profiles carry no shared semantics (v7 no-unifier constitution). Every field CANDIDATE until this lane is promoted from working/.

artifact_kind.description: The declared artifact kind, in the PRODUCER's vocabulary (e.g. 'nq.finding_snapshot.v2'). Not a shared type.

producer.description: The home project/system that mints this artifact kind.

wlp_receipt_kind.description: The WLP envelope kind this artifact rides in, when it does. ENVELOPE ONLY — carrying a WLP kind here shares syntax, never authority semantics (gap spec §6). Omit if the artifact is not WLP-carried.

local_payload_schema.description: Reference (id or content hash) to the payload schema VALID IN THE HOME PROJECT. Parsing against it proves shape, never authority — the parse-implies-authority move is the forbidden specimen.

stage_survived.description: Custody-ladder position the artifact has survived to, in the producer's OWN ladder. Cross-ladder comparison is meaningless without a bridge; a stage-n profile never authorizes stage n+1 (rung receipts pay ascent, one per rung).

allowed_local_uses.description: Uses the producer declares admissible IN THE HOME PROJECT. Absence of a use here is not a grant elsewhere.

forbidden_uses.description: Uses the producer explicitly forbids anywhere.

residue_caveats.description: Burdens/caveats the artifact carries (residue vocabulary, F3 lineage). Consumers inherit these; a bridge does not launder them.

bridge_obligations_required.description: Obligation ids that any cross-project or later-stage claim must discharge via a profile_bridge_receipt. Empty array = the producer declares no crossing is ever admissible from this profile alone... which still requires a bridge; this field names WHAT the bridge must pay.

non_authorities.description: What this artifact must NEVER be read as (explicit negative surface). Load-bearing: the gate checks attempted reads against this before any bridge logic.
